pages.title: Difficulty
lines: &7Free trial: &fT7 for 4:59 more, then back to T6
&7Beat difficulty mobs to bank Mastery Boost time (+10s each).
&7Mastery from hitting them: +50% while Momentum time is banked.
pages.notes: Staff view, trial active, difficulty ON (worst case). Non-staff: no Server tools / Combat rating row. Difficulty OFF: the toggle moves to the LEFT (x=16) as '&8Difficulty - OFF', style dim, action do:toggle_personal; Coin messages OFF is '&8Coin messages - OFF' dim. ISSUES: (1) the ON toggle sits alone in the RIGHT column (placeDifficultyToggle uses buttonRight when enabled), leaving the left cell empty; (2) 'Titles' and 'Coin messages' each take a whole row alone; (3) 'Replay the difficulty guide' is 27 chars on a 150px button (fits ~22), so it clips; (4) Home uses footerBackOnly, so 'Back to main menu' sits in the LEFT footer slot, while back() puts a system Home's single footer on the RIGHT (Rival Home); (5) the code comment says the staff entry 'reads red', but the label uses LABEL gray &7 with style normal; (6) Home rows use 'Label:' with a colon, other Difficulty pages use 'Label value' without one. Page id 'your_tier' renders this same page once the guide is done (skipped as a repeat).

mock.why: footerBackOnly puts the lone "Back to main menu" bottom LEFT; every other system Home has it bottom right (use back()); rows: today "Difficulty - ON" sits alone in the right column and Titles, Coin messages and Replay each take a whole row (openYourTier); pair them: [Difficulty - ON | Coin messages - ON] [Titles | Replay the difficulty guide] [Server tools | Combat rating]

pages.notes: Staff view (non-staff: no Staff Admin row). ISSUES: the 'TP Chat' button opens 'Rival settings', which also holds Instinct, so the label undersells the page. pages.title: Rivals
lines: &7Your rivals. Pick a player, then choose Silent, Declare, or Accept.
&7Free a Mutual slot to accept xXDragonSlayerXx
pages.notes: Worst case: 8 rivals and 4 incoming declares on page 1 of 2, mutual slots full. With 16-char names, rivalListLabel drops the '(Status)' tag, so no status shows on the list. ISSUES: (1) the per-declare name lines ('&7<name>', added by stackAcceptDecline because 'Accept xXDragonSlayerXx' is 23 chars) and the empty-state line are added with line() AFTER buttonsAfterLines(). The button origin was computed without them, so body text can run under the buttons. The same pattern is in openChallenge, openRequests and openReplacePick. The name lines also all gather at the end of the body instead of beside their Accept/Decline pair, so with 4 requests the player cannot tell which Accept belongs to whom. (2) Accept/Decline also appear on the Requests page. (3) 'Drop Mutual' is a vague label for 'pick a Mutual rival to demote'.

lines: &7Your rivals. Pick one to choose Silent, Declare or Accept.
&7Free a Mutual slot to accept xXDragonSlayerXx.
mock.why: openActions / placeRivalListButtons + stackAcceptDecline: 8 rival buttons in confirm green, then 4 anonymous Accept/Decline pairs stacked one per row, while the names they belong to sit in the body far above, and the body repeats the names a third time. The page is 576 px tall. Target: 6 rivals per page in the normal style, a pager row, and incoming requests only on the Requests page (the button says how many).

'Send challenge' is alone in a row. The page shows Wins/Losses but not Draws, though Records shows W/L/D.

pages.title: Rivals
pages.source: UltraRivalScreens.java openRecords('history') (approx line 575); RivalGuiApi.linesForPage default branch
pages.notes: BUG: openRecords' default branch calls RivalGuiApi.linesForPage(player, "records:history"). linesForPage matches 'history' but not 'records:history', so it falls to the default case. The History page therefore shows the generic RP/Mutual/Record/TP summary instead of RivalSystem.historyLines (past rivals). Mocked as the code builds it. If fixed, historyLines shows '&6&lPrevious Rivals' and rows like '&fxXDragonSlayerXx &8[PAST] &4Mythic Rival &7RP &f15000 &8- &a12&7/&c9&7/&e1', which have a raw '[PAST]' tag and a non-ASCII middle dot in RivalSystem.java. The current page's own button (History) is not marked.

pages.title: Rivals
pages.notes: Representative sub-record page. Season, Quests, Achievements, Hall of fame, Journal and Title share this layout (lines plus the same 8 record buttons) and are skipped. ISSUES: 'Rival TP bonus +200%' prints the multiplier (2.00 shown as 200%), while the tier perk says '+100% rival TP', so the two numbers contradict. Player copy includes a typed command '(/lm rival tpmsg)' and the abbreviation 'Career dmg'. RivalSystem.statsLines uses an em dash, and LmOverhaulScaledCombat.compactLines uses raw '§' and middle dots (wireText fixes them on the wire, but raw § in LM sources breaks the UltraStyle rule).

mock.why: openRequests: the body lists every invite (3 lines each) but the buttons show 4 anonymous Accept/Decline pairs stacked one per row (607 px tall). Target: one request per row, the name on its Accept button, Decline beside it.

pages.title: Rivals
pages.notes: Rival online, Mutual. The spin toggle is a fixedButton (ModelPreview.rotateButton) under the model box at legacy y=184, and the button flow starts below it. A Silent rival also gets '&aDeclare' (do:declare) or '&aAccept their declare' above Remove rival. An offline rival shows 'Model You, <form>' plus '&8They are offline, so the model shows you.' and no Show-you button. ISSUES: 'Model <name>' is odd player copy. The Proving Grounds lines come from ProvingGrounds.listLines with leading spaces and raw '§' codes (rival/ProvingGrounds.java) and have no heading. The 'Remove rival' button opens a page whose button says 'End rivalry', so one action has two names.
